map.各类建筑停车位配建标准计算与校核: Parking provision standard calculation and checking for all types of buildings
map.📖 查看「停车配比计算 使用指南」: 📖 Read the "Parking Ratio Calculator User Guide"
map.每户/每床/每座: Per household / per bed / per seat
map.总车位 = 建筑规模 ÷ 配建单位 × 配建指标: Total spaces = building scale ÷ provision unit × provision standard
map.访客车位 = 总车位 × 访客比例；常规车位 = 总车位 − 访客车位: Visitor spaces = total spaces × visitor ratio; regular spaces = total spaces − visitor spaces
map.停车面积 = 总车位 × 单个车位面积（含通道约 25~35 m²/车位）: Parking area = total spaces × area per space (including aisle, about 25~35 m² per space)
map.无障碍车位：总车位 × 无障碍比例（不少于总车位2%）: Accessible spaces: total spaces × accessible ratio (not less than 2% of total spaces)
map.💡 配建标准因城市规模而异，特大城市要求最高。实际项目应以当地规划部门的具体规定: 💡 Provision standards vary by city size, with the strictest requirements in megacities. Actual projects should follow the specific rules of the local planning authority. Visitor spaces are generally not less than 15~20% of the total.
map.📚 深度解析：停车位配建计算: 📚 Deep dive: Parking Space Provision Calculation
map.建设工程规划许可前，按建筑类型与城市规模查\"配建停车位指标\"，计算应配建车位: Before a construction project obtains planning approval, look up the "parking space provision standard" by building type and city size, and compute the required spaces = building scale ÷ unit × standard.
map.住宅、办公、商业、酒店、医院、学校、文体场馆、公园等配建口径不同（按户/按: Residential, office, commercial, hotel, hospital, school, culture and sports venues and parks use different provision bases (per household / per
map.在总车位中拆分无障碍车位（≥2%）与访客车位（按比例），并估算停车面积。: Split the accessible spaces (≥2%) and visitor spaces (by ratio) out of the total spaces, and estimate the parking area.
map.配建指标按什么口径取值？: On what basis is the provision standard taken?
map.住宅按\"户\"、办公/商业/医院按\"建筑面积（每 100 m²）\"、酒店按: Residential is counted per "household", office / commercial / hospital per "floor area (per 100 m²)", hotel per "number of guest rooms", school per "number of students (per 100 students)", culture and sports venues per "number of seats (per 100 seats)", and parks per "land area (per 1000 m²)". Standards decrease stepwise from megacity / metropolis / medium city / small city (e.g. residential 1.0 / 0.8 / 0.6 / 0.5).
map.无障碍车位怎么配？: How are accessible parking spaces provided?
map.无障碍停车位数量一般不少于总车位的 2%（且不少于 1 个），应靠近出入口、地面: Accessible parking spaces are generally not less than 2% of the total spaces (and not less than 1 space); they should be close to entrances and accessible at ground level. Visitor spaces are listed separately by ratio and are not counted as accessible spaces.
